title: Africa, to Scale
stage: Geographic feasibility draft — await review before final styling
source: Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 Countries 5.1.1, standard countries file
africa_definition: Union of Natural Earth REGION_UN=Africa units, plus complete French Mayotte and Reunion components. Includes Madagascar, island states and the source's remote island dependencies; includes whole Egypt including Sinai. Source-country regional aggregate, not a tectonic or mainland-only definition. All selected source components retained and membership saved.
area_definition: WGS84 ellipsoidal surface area of selected country polygons, preserving source holes. Standard country geometry is not a separate dry-land mask; inland water is included wherever enclosed by the source polygons. Not mixed with published land-only statistics.
country_projection: Each selected country locally centered WGS84 Lambert azimuthal equal-area; planar straight-edge representation geodesically densified to10km, then minute numerical normalization to its geodesic source-polygon area

comparison_components.USA48: All USA source polygon components with representative point in lon[-125,-66],lat[24,50]; retains represented coastal islands, excludes Alaska/Hawaii. Label contiguous United States.
comparison_components.IND: Entire India feature, including detached represented islands; source de facto boundaries.
comparison_components.CHN: Entire China feature including Hainan and represented islands; Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macao separate source features not included.
comparison_components.DEU: Entire Germany feature and represented islands.
comparison_components.JPN: Entire Japan feature and represented islands.

placement_policy: No cutting, clipping, stretching or post-preparation scaling. Search proxies only speed feasibility; containment/overlap verified on actual unsimplified delivered shapes. Countries not geographically adjacent after moving.
political_convention: Natural Earth de facto country features; dissolve Africa to avoid double counting adjacent units including Morocco/Western Sahara and Somalia/Somaliland. No sovereignty endorsement. Country IDs and component exclusions logged.
